rows.label: Formula part 1
rows.value: Taxable income below CHF 15,000 (2005 tariff): tax-free (Steuerfreigrenze)
rows.basis: Taxable income, per year (simple tax, before the multipliers)
rows.note: Tariff vintage: Formula of the 2005 tariff, CPI-indexed by the canton (the 2026 table was not read), per ESTV Kantonsblatt (Stand Februar 2026).

rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: Married couples and single parents living with children or supported persons: the rate of half the taxable income, at least the minimum rate (§ 34 Abs. 2 Steuergesetz)
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Basel-Landschaft (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, § 34 Steuergesetz

rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Basel-Landschaft (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, § 34 Steuergesetz

rows.label: Indexation (§ 20 Steuergesetz)
rows.value: The formula is the 2005 tariff (CPI June 2004 = 104.0, base May 2000); for each later year the income is converted by the change in the CPI before the formula is applied
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Basel-Landschaft (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, § 34 Steuergesetz

rows.label: Child tax reduction (§ 34 Abs. 4)
rows.value: CHF 750 per child off the income tax
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Basel-Landschaft (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, § 34 Steuergesetz

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Liestal; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier
rows.value: No multiple: the tariff gives the cantonal tax (ESTV note 3)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Liestal; other communes in Basel-Landschaft set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.label: Cantonal profit tax (Ertragssteuer) rate from 1 January 2025
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Basel-Landschaft (Stand Februar 2026), Juristische Personen: Steuerberechnung, § 58 StG

rows.label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer)
rows.value: None: the canton and its municipalities levy no property tax
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)

rows.label: Transfer tax rate paid by the seller
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Basel-Landschaft Gesetz über die Staats- und Gemeindesteuern (Steuergesetz, SGS 331), Stand 1. Januar 2023, § 84
